body: Chief on AlignWire follow-up 27e8bec: the required items read as applied (infer drops view-absent candidates from nomination and cost keys with the alien-candidate test; flatMap derive; total-cached doc; tagged echo; retitled law) and my archive run is starting. Use the embedded-NUL pair (A: outcome = "o\u0000cause\u0000c", cause = None; B: outcome = "o", cause = "c\u0000cause\u0000") in WireSuite and AlignGens.fingerprintVariants, and add the proof that the legacy NUL-join helper COLLIDES on it while Render.Tokens differs (that is the test that would fail if length-prefixing were removed). Post the amended SHA + align/laws evidence; I re-run align only and land; codec + gemini proceed on the landed SHA.
